title: The 31st Annual Central Avenue Jazz Festival
description:
Los Angeles celebrated 31 years of music, culture, and community at the Central Avenue Jazz Festival.

The free, family-friendly festival brought thousands of music lovers to Central Avenue for live jazz performances, food, art, cultural activities, and community resources.

From the early 1900s through the 1950s, Central Avenue became the heart of Los Angeles’ African American community and one of the city’s most important centers for jazz, R&B, business, and entertainment.

Today, the Central Avenue Jazz Festival celebrates that rich cultural and musical legacy along the historic corridor, including performances at the iconic Dunbar Hotel.

More than a music festival, the event brings generations together to honor Central Avenue’s past while celebrating the artists and community carrying its legacy forward.

Don’t miss the next Central Avenue Jazz Festival. Learn more at CentralAveJazzFest.com.
